liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): This soundboard version leaves out Not Fade Away, so the reviewer considers it incomplete [12]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Reviewer usually skips Cassidy but replays this version, enjoying the performance [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-10-11.142012.sbd.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 33 songs; 211 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1980-10-11.155431.sbd.1gen.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 31 songs; 211 min [3]
- **gd1980-10-11.156343.akg-se5-wiseman-miller-clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 31 songs; 197 min [5]
- **gd80-10-11.acoustic-sbd.windsor.323.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 45 min; rated 4.8/5 by 20 [9]. Said about its sound: Very clean acoustic soundboard, with quality comparable to the Reckoning album; the playing is smooth and tight; Acoustic set only, with a strong vocal mix and a lot of Jerry's playing; Exceptionally pure sound, even when streamed; the reviewer finds it more clear than famous Betty Board recordings [16][21][22]
- **gd80-10-11.sbd-acoustic.windsor.clevenger.fix-323.6198.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 45 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [10]

## Around the show

- John Cipollina guested in the later part of the show, which this soundboard lacks [13]
- John Cippolina sat in from Not Fade Away through One More Saturday Night; the first set was acoustic [1]
- John Cippolina joined the band from Not Fade Away through One More Saturday Night [3]
- The acoustic set is described as one of many strong acoustic sets played at the Warfield [14]
- This set sounds better and more polished than the first few shows of the Warfield run, showing the band's adjustments [17]
- Reviewer rates the sound possibly the best among the Archive's 1980 acoustic set recordings [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-10-11.142012.sbd.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Matt Smith; source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Cassettes > 1st generation cassettes > Matt Smith's 2nd generation cassettes; Transfer Info: 2nd generation cassettes (Nakamichi… [1]
- **gd1980-10-11.155431.sbd.1gen.miller.t.flac16**: transferred by Transfer and Mastering by Charlie Miller  January 15, 2022; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550) > Cassette (Sony TC-D5M/TDK SA-C90) [3]. Also: Patched from several sources by Scott Clugston, Matt Smith, Jeff Knudsen and Ron Ellner, with pitch correction settings from Joe B. Jones [3]
- **gd1980-10-11.156343.akg-se5-wiseman-miller-clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [5]. Also: Ron Ellner's Nakamichi 700 source supplies some crowd sound, the openings of Dire Wolf and China Cat Sunflower, and a patch in the Space to Not Fade Away transition [5]
- **gd80-10-11.acoustic-sbd.windsor.323.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]
- **gd80-10-11.sbd-acoustic.windsor.clevenger.fix-323.6198.shnf**: source: Soundboard->Reel->PCM->DAT->CDR [10]. Also: Bob Clevenger normalized the levels using EAC and DART Pro 98 [10]
